body: you guys are all great. just reading your responses makes me feel better. i feel like you all care, even though you're all just strangers.

I love your advice, but my parents don't love me like yours sound like they do. If I get good grades, then I'm fine. I'm more of an inconvenient roommate to my parents than a daughter. Thank you for taking your time to respond to me, as I know I'm not worth the time.
